QuestInfo.name: The Girl who lost her Innocence
QuestInfo.0: Korin looks sad. Ludibrium is a happy place, such looks don't belong here. Go speak with Korin.
QuestInfo.1: Korin wants to become an adult but Ludibrium's time does not change. Korin needs #r#t4033863##k from monsters that eat time.
QuestInfo.2: You gave #r#t4033863##k to Korin who wants to become an adult. But whyd does Korin want to be an adult anyway?

0.0: Why did the king of Ludibrium want time stopped? So that people rediscover their innocence? But what happens when people lose their innocence? The citizens may have the bodies of children, but their minds are mature...
0.1: I want to become an adult. I hate being a child. I know my wish is forbidden in Ludibrium, but I can't take it any longer. Can you please help me?

yes.0: Time doesn't flow in Ludibrium because time itself is locked away in the Clocktower. The monsters in there eat time and create #r#t4033863##k. I need those eggs. Can you bring me #r50#k #r#t4033863##k items? Maybe I can become an adult if I eat them.

no.0: Having to live as a child is cruel.

1.0: Ah this must be #t4033863# items... Maybe I can eat them to become an adult.

default.0: Maybe I can become an adult by eating #r50#k #r#t4033863##k items.
